statements.subject: session
statements.description: These commands, and a '250 OK' reply to one of them, confirm that both the SMTP client and the SMTP server are in the initial state, that is, there is no transaction in progress and all state tables and buffers are cleared.
statements.invariant_cond: transaction.in_progress = false & state_tables.cleared = true & buffers.cleared = true

statements.subject: session
statements.description: A client SMTP SHOULD start an SMTP session by issuing the EHLO command.

statements.subject: session

statements.post_cond: transaction.in_progress = false & state_tables.cleared = true & buffers.cleared = true

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: A client MUST issue HELO or EHLO before starting a mail transaction.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: A client MUST issue HELO or EHLO before starting a mail transaction.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the SMTP server supports the SMTP service extensions, it will give a successful response, a failure response, or an error response. If the SMTP server, in violation of this specification, does not support any SMTP service extensions, it will generate an error response.
actions: send 250 successful response | send failure response | send error response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Older client SMTP systems MAY use HELO instead of EHLO, and servers MUST support the HELO command and reply properly to it.
